title: Checks for files that are included as modules multiple times.
summary: Loading a file as a module more than once causes it to be compiled multiple times, taking longer and putting duplicate content into the module tree. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for function arguments having the similar names differing by an underscore.
summary: It affects code readability. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for attributes that appear two or more times.
summary: Repeating an attribute on the same item (or globally on the same crate) is unnecessary and doesn’t have an effect. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for instances where a std::time::Duration is constructed using a smaller time unit when the value could be expressed more clearly using a larger unit.
summary: Using a smaller unit for a duration that is evenly divisible by a larger unit reduces readability. Readers have to mentally convert values, which can be error-prone and makes the code less clear. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for calculation of subsecond microseconds or milliseconds from other Duration methods.
summary: It’s more concise to call Duration::subsec_micros() or Duration::subsec_millis() than to calculate them. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.
